description: This file contains step definitions and utility functions for testing Python logging behavior within a BDD framework (Behave). It defines steps for creating, asserting, and verifying log records and their output, including schema definitions and configuration settings.

classes.name: LogRecordTable
classes.description: Utility class for formatting and annotating log record tables.

methods.name: make_log_record
methods.description: Creates and logs a log record with specified category, level, and message.

methods.name: make_formatter
methods.description: Constructs a logging.Formatter object based on format and date format.

methods.name: make_log_record_output
methods.description: Generates formatted log record output string from category, level, and message.

methods.name: LogRecordTable.make_output_for_row
methods.description: Generates formatted output for a table row representing a log record.

methods.name: LogRecordTable.annotate_with_row_schema
methods.description: Adds missing columns to a log record table based on a schema.
